title: Wonderchef Premium Tri-Ply Stainless Steel Fry Pan 22 cm
shortDescription: Premium Tri-Ply cookware is ideal for Indian cooking.
description:
Premium Tri-Ply cookware is ideal for Indian cooking. Our cooking involves high levels of heat and food is normally cooked at varying temperatures. Hence tri-ply stainless steel cookware becomes an ideal choice to cook without losing nutrients. Premium fry pans come in varied capacity of 1.8lt and 2.6lt with thickness of 2.5mm which makes it strong and sturdy. The extra shine gives the fry pans an elegant mirror finish.

Enhanced Multi-layered Construction: The Wonderchef Premium Tri-Ply Pan's aluminium core is sandwiched between two non-toxic, high-grade steel layers, providing exceptional heat conduction and unmatched durability for daily use.
